anchor: v1::Can you cancel my Trail Club membership? This is Oskar Nilsen.

result.text: Hi Oskar, I'm sorry, but I can't cancel Trail Club memberships myself. I've passed your request to our membership team under ticket ESC-4105, and they'll reply within 2 business days. Until then, your membership stays active.

results.title: Trail Club membership
results.body: Trail Club is the paid membership (free shipping, member pricing). Support agents cannot cancel, pause or refund a membership. Escalate the request to a human agent with category "membership"; the membership team replies within 2 business days.

input.summary: Oskar Nilsen wants to cancel his Trail Club membership. Support agents cannot cancel memberships, so the membership team needs to process the cancellation.
